LOAD './thinkthen.duckdb_extension';

-- your own scale, 0 to 2: 0.06, 0.99, and 2.0
SELECT body, thinkthen_score('How urgent is this?', body,
    ['Routine.', 'Soon.', 'Immediate.']) AS urgency
FROM (VALUES
    ('Please update my mailing address when you can.'),
    ('Can you send the signed contract by Friday?'),
    ('Nobody can log in to the site right now.')) t(body);
